name: Identical If/ElseIf bodies
description: Flags consecutive If/ElseIf branches whose bodies are the same, often a copy-paste oversight.
definition: Flags, as an `[info]`, an `ElseIf` (or the first `ElseIf` after an `If`) whose body is structurally identical to the immediately preceding branch's body in the same `If` statement (e.g. `If a` / `Debug.Trace("x")` followed by `ElseIf b` / `Debug.Trace("x")`). Only consecutive branches are compared; a later branch that matches a non-adjacent earlier one is left alone, and an `Else` body is never compared this way. Empty bodies are left to `empty-body` rather than double-flagged here. Bodies are matched structurally while ignoring source locations, so two copy-pasted blocks on different lines still count as the same. This is a soft hint that a condition or body change may have been forgotten, not a hard correctness error — so it stays off in the `standard` and `careful` presets (low importance, not `kept_in_standard`).
